claims.text: Every visit: age-appropriate exam, with an infant totally unclothed and older children undressed and suitably draped.
claims.quote: At each visit, age-appropriate physical examination is essential, with infant totally unclothed and older children undressed and suitably draped.

claims.text: Measure and plot on appropriate WHO Growth Chart: recumbent length; weight; head circumference; weight-for-length.
claims.quote: Measure and plot on appropriate WHO Growth Chart – Recumbent length – Weight – Head circumference – Weight-for-length
claims.locator: 4 month visit, Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Skin: inspect for skin lesions, birthmarks, and bruising.
claims.quote: Skin – Inspect for skin lesions, birthmarks, and bruising.
claims.locator: 4 month visit, Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Head: palpate for positional skull deformities.

claims.locator: 4 month visit, Health Supervision: Physical Examination

claims.text: Eyes: examine pupils for opacification and red reflexes; assess visual acuity using fixate and follow response.

claims.text: Heart: auscult for heart murmurs; palpate femoral pulses.

claims.text: Musculoskeletal: assess for developmental hip dysplasia by examining for leg length discrepancy, thigh-fold asymmetry, and appropriate abduction.

claims.text: Neurologic: evaluate tone, strength, and symmetry of movements; diminishing primitive reflexes.
